HOW IT WORKS

FROM IDEA to ink

01

Consult

Tell us the idea — placement, size, style. We sketch directions and match you with the right artist. Free, no pressure.

02

Design

Your artist draws a custom design for your body and placement. You approve every line before any needle touches skin.

03

Session

Sterile setup, single-use needles, numbing on request. You watch the design come alive — breaks whenever you need.

04

Aftercare

Full aftercare kit and instructions. Free touch-up check within the healing window — we stand by the work.

STERILE. Every time.

A tattoo is forever — so is our hygiene protocol.

Single-use needlesOpened in front of you, disposed after one session. Never reused.
Hospital-grade sterilizationAutoclaved equipment, medical disinfectants, barrier-wrapped stations.
Fresh ink, every clientSingle-use ink caps — your ink never touches another client's.
Trained professionalsBloodborne-pathogen trained artists. Ask us anything — we answer.
